relationships.subject: Restraint stress
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings reflect the development of latent sensitization (LS) induced by repeated episodes of stress in both male and female mice.

relationships.subject: Propranolol
relationships.evidence_quote: propranolol administered prior to each RS abolished the development of CA as well as the induction of LS in female mice

relationships.subject: nor-BNI
relationships.evidence_quote: In nor-BNI pretreated mice, UMB no longer elicited CA, suggesting that nor-BNI prevented the development of LS.

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Olcegepant fully blocked the development of UMB-induced CA in RS-primed mice

relationships.subject: Sumatriptan
relationships.evidence_quote: Sumatriptan fully reversed UMB-induced periorbital CA to similar levels as in control animals

relationships.subject: Umbellulone
relationships.evidence_quote: mediated CGRP release from trigeminal neurons through activation of TRPA1 channels

key_findings: Olcegepant blocked umbellulone-induced allodynia in stress-primed mice when given before but not after the challenge, indicating a time-dependent role for CGRP receptor signalling
Sumatriptan reversed established allodynia, while propranolol and nor-BNI prevented priming only when given before stress
novel_terms: restraint stress two-hit priming model of migraine-like pain
